answer_1.quote: We study the task of sentence infilling, which requires the model to handle inter-sentential correlation and to predict missing semantic information.
answer_1.outputs: generated sentences that fit contextually and semantically into missing positions in text

answer_2.quote: Following , we perform automatic evaluation using standard machine translation metrics, including BLEU , NIST , and METEOR .

answer_4.quote: We performed human evaluation of our method on the TripAdvisor dataset. We used a crowd evaluation platform to compare two systems and assess their fluency, informativeness, and relevance to the surrounding context (coherence) on 500 random samples from the test set.
answer_4.guideline: assess their fluency, informativeness, and relevance to the surrounding context (coherence)
